images.filename: Antigua Guatemala, ruinas de la catedral 07.JPG
images.caption: Ruins of the cathedral of Antigua Guatemala. Memorial stone place in 1960 to mark the tombs of Francisco Marroquín, first bishop of Guatemala, conquistador Pedro de Alvarado, his wife Beatriz de la Cueva, and daughter Leonor de Alvarado, conquistadors Pedro de Portocarrero, Francisco de la Cueva and Bernal Díaz del Castillo, and Luisa Xicoténcatl, Pedro de Alvarado's concubine.
images.alt: Ruins of the cathedral of Antigua Guatemala. Memorial stone place in 1960 to mark the tombs of Francisco Marroquín, first bishop of Guatemala, conquistador Pedro de Alvarado, his wife Beatriz de la Cueva, and daughter Leonor de Alvarado, conquistadors Pedro de Portocarrero, Francisco de la Cueva and Bernal Díaz del Castillo, and Luisa Xicoténcatl, Pedro de Alvarado's concubine.
